title: Banana Reid: I published a 3D iOS game with ChatGPT (Astra 6) and Codex, starting with no coding or graphics skills
author: InternSevere5430
selftext:
On October 8, 2026, I published Banana Reid, a 3D mobile game, on the App Store. I started without programming or graphic design skills, relying on AI and Codex to turn my idea into a game.

For AI, I mainly used ChatGPT (Astra 6), together with Codex. My workflow was to describe what I wanted a feature or screen to do, have the AI implement it, test the result, and describe what needed to change. I repeated that loop until publication.

The main lesson for me was that generating code doesn't finish the game. I still had to make the decisions about what I wanted and test whether the result matched the idea. Being able to describe a problem clearly was a big part of my role.

I'm sharing this journey for anyone who has an idea but doesn't yet have the technical skills to build it.

Banana Reid on the App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/it/app/banana-reid/id6813514944](https://apps.apple.com/it/app/banana-reid/id6813514944)
